name: nc-edit7-desktop
author: d-creations
description: NC-Edit7 Desktop App based on Eclipse Theia

scripts.build: npm run verify:theia-exports && npm run ensure:theia-native && theia build
scripts.build:ext: cd node_modules/nccode7lab && npm install && cd ../.. && npm run patch:ext && npm --prefix node_modules/nccode7lab run compile
scripts.copy:ext: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'plugins/nccode7lab' | Out-Null; robocopy 'node_modules/nccode7lab' 'plugins/nccode7lab' /MIR /R:2 /W:1 /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP; if ($LASTEXITCODE -gt 7) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } else { exit 0 }"
scripts.update:ext: npm update nccode7lab && npm run build:ext && npm run copy:ext && npm run verify:theia-exports
scripts.package:prepare: npm run build && npm run build:ext && npm run copy:ext
scripts.build:github: npm run package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.github.yml --publish never
scripts.release:github: npm run package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.github.yml --publish always
scripts.build:store: npm run package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.microsoft-store.yml --publish never
